title: Practice: choose the extension a situation calls for, and say why (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 every situation of the bank gets its mechanism and its reason
cases.says: Each of the twenty-eight situations of the scenario bank gets its mechanism and its reason code

cases.id: e1 a rule that must hold goes to a hook whatever else is true
cases.says: A rule that must hold goes to a hook whatever else is true

cases.id: e2 an outside system needs a server and noisy work alone needs a subagent
cases.says: An outside system needs a server, and noisy work alone needs a subagent

cases.id: e3 knowledge goes to the file or skill that loads it at the right time
cases.says: Knowledge goes to the file or skill that loads it at the right time

cases.id: e4 a plugin carries a skill hook subagent or server to a second repository and nothing else
cases.says: A plugin carries a skill, hook, subagent or server to a second repository and nothing else

cases.id: e5 in an application the platform may supply the schema and only a remote server replaces your own tool
cases.says: In an application the platform may supply the schema, and only a remote server replaces your own tool

cases.id: e6 an unknown value is an error and a missing key takes its default
cases.says: An unknown value is an error and a missing key takes its default

cases.id: e7 a pipeline a condition a long command and an event are not intervals
cases.says: A pipeline, a condition, a long command and an event are not intervals

cases.id: e8 an interval is a loop in the session and a routine or desktop task when it must outlive it
cases.says: An interval is a loop in the session, and a routine or desktop task when it must outlive it
